content.overview: For the purposes of the foregoing provisions of Chapter XXII: (a) the expression ‘certified’ means certified in the prescribed manner to be a true copy or a correct translation; (b) the expression ‘director’, in relation to a foreign company, includes any person in accordance with whose directions or instructions the Board of Directors of the company is accustomed to act; and (c) the expression ‘place of business’ includes a share transfer or share registration office.
content.glance: Chapter XXII definitions: ‘certified’ (true copy/translation), ‘director’ (includes shadow directors), ‘place of business’ (includes share transfer/registration office).
content.study: Section 386 supplies interpretation for Chapter XXII. ‘Certified’ means certified in the prescribed manner as a true copy or correct translation. ‘Director’ in relation to a foreign company includes any person in accordance with whose directions or instructions the Board is accustomed to act. ‘Place of business’ includes a share transfer or share registration office. The primary definition of ‘foreign company’ remains in section 2(42); section 386 does not redefine it.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: For Chapter XXII: certified means prescribed true copy/translation; director includes persons on whose directions the Board acts; place of business includes share transfer/registration office.

examples.title: Illustration — s. 386
examples.body: A foreign company maintains a share registration office in India; under s. 386(c) that office is a place of business for Chapter XXII purposes.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 386?
hypotheticals.analysis: It defines certified, director and place of business for Chapter XXII without displacing the s. 2(42) definition of foreign company.

rows.left: Chapter XXII interpretation of certified, director, place of business

misconceptions.trap: Treating s. 386 as the definition of foreign company.
misconceptions.correction: Foreign company is defined in s. 2(42); s. 386 defines certified, director and place of business for Chapter XXII.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 386 be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the expression in issue. II. Apply the Chapter XXII meaning. III. Keep s. 2(42) distinct for ‘foreign company’.
